need: An interval (cases-based) on every gate figure: balanced accuracy overall and accuracy within each cell
why: The only survivor clears the overall gate by under a point and its nearest cell floor by a few points; without an interval the report cannot say whether either clearance is borderline, and dot_interval draws bare dots that read as certain
workaround: State in the flag, captions and confidence that every gate reads a point estimate; carry the overall clearance as an open caveat

need: settle: the cases needed to separate the recommended option's overall balanced accuracy from the 90% gate, and its Complex x News cell from the 80% floor
why: Watch and next steps should say whether more cases or a changed configuration is what settles the thin clearance
workaround: Say in words that the clearance is unresolved and that the first step is computing the interval on the frozen cases

need: Lever effects over the factorial grid: what each prompt style buys per model, as signed deltas, with an interaction check
why: Rubric + reasoning raises two models and lowers the third; the claim that the levers interact rests on reading nine lattice tiles by eye, and diverging_bars has no lever-delta source
workaround: Show the lattice for the grid and a confusion pair for the one model the rubric hurts; state the interaction in words with the two balanced-accuracy keys

need: Confusion within one target-matrix cell (which axis, complexity or domain, carries the errors in Complex x News)
why: Complex x News is the binding cell for every configuration and the one that keeps the cheapest near-passing option out; a fix needs to know whether it misreads complexity or domain there
workaround: Show per-axis confusion over all cases and say the per-cell split is not available; name it as a next step

need: A figure-key check action: resolve a list of figure keys against the snapshot without rendering a block
why: Drafting prose needs to confirm every key resolves before submission; the mechanical checker is not reachable from the analyst tool yet
workaround: Put all keys in the title of a one-row table block_render and read the resolved title

need: confound_check: whether the rubric arm's two changes (a rubric and a reasoning step) can be separated, and whether latency was measured on a shared machine
why: Rubric + reasoning bundles two levers, so its accuracy gain and its latency cost cannot be credited to either one; the snapshot carries no latency caveat either way
workaround: Name the bundle in Watch-adjacent prose and propose a rubric-without-reasoning run as a next step
